BuiltWith.description:
The build that wrote the manifest (the determinism settings: nothing here is
configurable at run time).

avian_features.description: The avian3d features the physics was built with.

JsonOrbital.description:
One Space-Track GP (OMM JSON) record: the keys the sim reads. Other keys of a
record are ignored on read and not written back. `project.json` carries it as the
snapshot a body starts from.

inertia_kg_m2.description:
Inertia tensor in kg m², row-major; finite, symmetric and positive definite.
It is taken in the sim's ECI-aligned axes at spawn: every body starts with
the identity attitude and the sim has no attitude model. Absent: the
collider's inertia scaled to the mass.

label.description: Display name. Must not be blank.

mass_kg.description:
Mass in kg; greater than 0. The chaser's is the tether root's (the root is
the chaser); without it the root takes the plan's `end_mass_kg`.

source.description: Where the orbit came from. Provenance only: the orbit is the source of truth.

ManifestElements.description:
Osculating Keplerian elements, metres and radians (degrees would not round-trip
bit for bit), valid at `epoch_utc`.

epoch_utc.description: The epoch the six elements are valid at, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.ffffffZ` (UTC).

raan_rad.description: Right ascension of the ascending node in radians.

semi_major_axis_m.description: Semi-major axis in metres; greater than 0.

ManifestOrbit.description: How a body's initial state is given: exactly one key.

oneOf.description:
The Space-Track GP (OMM JSON) record verbatim. The body starts from SGP4, as
an unedited catalog pick does.
Osculating Keplerian elements in metres and radians.

Chaser only: an offset from the target along V-bar or R-bar. Refused until
v0.4.0-rc.5.

ManifestSource.description: Where a body's orbit was taken from.

dataset.description: Path of the dataset file, relative to the project folder.

norad_id.description: NORAD catalog id of the record.

RecordingBlock.description:
The `recording` block of `project.json`: every key is optional and falls back
to the default named here. Durations are simulation seconds.

auto_start_phase.description:
Start a recording when the capture enters this phase (a phase id of the
active plan). Absent: no automatic start.

auto_stop_on_end.description:
Stop the recording `stop_after_end_s` after the capture enters an end phase.
Default `true`.

keyframe_interval_steps.description: Steps between two frames (K); at least 1. Default 32.

max_duration_s.description: The longest recording; greater than 0. Default 1800.

max_size_mb.description: The largest keyframe table in megabytes; greater than 0. Default 100.

max_tether_bodies.description: The most tether bodies a recording may hold; at least 1. Default 200.

stop_after_end_s.description: Seconds recorded after the end event; greater than 0. Default 60.

RelativePreset.description: The approach line of a chaser placed relative to the target.

RelativeToTarget.description: A chaser placed relative to the target.

offset_m.description: Distance from the target in metres.

description:
The project manifest, schema v1. Lengths are metres, angles radians, masses kg,
epochs UTC strings with microseconds.

active_plan.description:
Id (file stem) of the capture plan to run. Absent: the project's only plan,
else `example_plan`.

built_with.description: The build that wrote the file; read only by `ssg-sim validate`.

name.description: Display name of the project. Must not be blank.

recording.description: When and how this project records. Absent: manual recording only.

start_epoch_utc.description:
The simulation start epoch, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.ffffffZ` (UTC, microseconds).
The simulation always starts from exactly this string.

title: ProjectManifest
